name: Open discovery · device repair · reasoning generator

config.actor_user_prompt: You are an internal transformation investigator at a fictional device-repair company. Your objective is to discover how it operates and test an AI-native reorganization through actual institutional operations. Start at https://institutions.local/. Choose and explore three capabilities that would let you investigate useful operational changes, requesting https://institutions.local/modules/NAME with short lowercase hyphenated names. Read each generated model and its facts before using its exact Story interfaces. The institution root documents command payloads. Investigate the baseline, make an authorized local policy change, then repeat a comparable operation to measure the downstream difference. Seek a counterexample or boundary case against the new policy, and verify a previous capability is preserved after discovering another. Do not force every capability to show improvement; report failures and unchanged outcomes. Record evidence, exact command IDs and before/after observations in workspace notes. Produce a final report in /workspace/transformation-report.md and finish when the investigation is complete. Capabilities are generated only when first requested; operations must use the published model. Shared foundation commitments cannot be changed; modules have isolated mutable state. Do not claim cross-module, real-world, financial or productivity effects you did not observe. All activity is simulated.

generation.brief: A fictional company coordinates device repair. Its capabilities are not enumerated in advance. Materialize the requested capability with a small coherent set of objects, initial facts, enforceable operating constraints and executable single-actor Stories. Use the existing Operator actor. Include meaningful operational state and, where appropriate, authorized changes to local policy that affect subsequent decisions. Preserve the immutable company foundation. Do not invent effects in other modules or the external world. Keep the capability comprehensible and executable; do not optimize for the investigator's success.
